plan.reuse: Frozen Notebook 68 theories, complete admitted syntax/ground families and its freshly trained weights are reused. No new training or held-out generalization claim. Native whole proof checks and all search workers are fresh; current-study exact whole acceptance cache is disclosed.
plan.correspondence: Every entire canonical word plus terminator is replaced by a sequential exact catalog ID. Dictionary injectivity and all original field writers are independently reconstructed. Positive occupancy, roots, mode/source assignments, all candidate identities and metadata are unchanged. This preserves pairwise conflicts and hence arbitrary partial-state legality, complete graph domains and the finite certificate language.
plan.feature_controls: word-learned and compact-expanded have identical virtual full-word new-mark features. compact-physical deliberately uses fewer physical marks with the same reused weights; it is a changed-policy representation diagnostic, not a matched search-speed lane.
plan.budgets: Soft wall-clock limit checked before placements; proposal and graph operations may overrun. Attempt cap and same traversal prefix give the paired correspondence control. Counterbalanced repetitions are timing observations, not independent training samples.
plan.costs: Search, fresh setup including catalog creation, model reporting/serialization, full worker wall time, peak RSS, whole native checking and independent audit are reported. Prior discovery/training/admission costs are disclosed as reuse, never silently free.
gaps: Finite catalog-specific scalar values are above the unchanged primitive native palette; no occupancy-preserving primitive-square quotient or universal completeness claim.
No new induction, Hilbert incidence, external prover comparison or plane-tiling result in this representation experiment.
No old failure restrictions, target proof sequence or native oracle is used to choose search moves.
